@\izna_offcl Twitter Update With #MAI

[izME📮]

Happy naya Day!!!!
naya!! I can’t believe it’s already been two years since we’ve been together; time seems to have flown by so fast, yet looking back, I realize we’ve shared so many happy moments 🥺💕💖
Every single moment became a special memory because you were always right there by my side, naya. Thank you so much—truly—for always believing in me, cheering me on, and loving me without fail 🤍✨
Whenever I’m on stage and hear your cheers, I find myself wanting to show you an even better version of myself; I want to give back even more strength than the love and support you send my way.
The past two years we’ve spent together have been so precious, but the time we’ll create together in the future will be even happier and more special, so let’s stay together for a long, long time 😌 Thank you always, and I love you, naya 🩷
